Class GrpcWebController

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.protobuf.json.GrpcWebController
@Singleton @ExecuteOn("blocking") @Controller("/${micronaut.grpc.web.path:`grpc-web`}") public final class GrpcWebController extends Object
HTTP/1.1 bridge that exposes annotated gRPC services via the gRPC-Web wire protocol.
